beforeEach hook
Fixture "ownerContext"
Create context
Fixture "ownerPage"
Create page
Navigate to "/restaurant/restaurantId/5f12beef-c34c-4316-a601-d228eaa3b2ef/restaurantManagement?tab=create-promotion"
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Create a promotion', level: 1 })
Click getByRole('radio', { name: /^(Selected )?Buy one, get one / })
Expect "toBeChecked" getByRole('radio', { name: /^(Selected )?Buy one, get one / })
Click getByRole('group', { name: 'They buy', exact: true }).first().getByRole('button', { name: 'Choose from these items', exact: true })
Fill "AUTO Promo Wrap 7965fff3" getByRole('group', { name: 'They buy', exact: true }).first().getByRole('combobox', { name: 'They buy', exact: true })
Click getByRole('option', { name: /^AUTO Promo Wrap 7965fff3/ })
Fill "AUTO Promo Bowl 7965fff3" getByRole('group', { name: 'They buy', exact: true }).first().getByRole('combobox', { name: 'They buy', exact: true })
Click getByRole('option', { name: /^AUTO Promo Bowl 7965fff3/ })
Click getByRole('group', { name: 'They buy', exact: true }).first().getByRole('button', { name: 'Add these choices', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('group', { name: 'They buy', exact: true }).first().getByText('Customer chooses one', { exact: true })
Click getByRole('button', { name: /^Same item/ }).or(getByRole('radio', { name: /^Same item/ }))
Click getByRole('button', { name: /^For a set price/ }).or(getByRole('radio', { name: /^For a set price/ }))
Fill "1.99" getByRole('textbox', { name: 'They pay', exact: true })
Fill "AUTO BOGO 7965fff3" getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Promotion name', exact: true })
Expect "toContainText" locator('.MuiPaper-root').filter({ has: getByRole('heading', { name: 'Preview', exact: true, level: 2 }) }).last()
Wait for event "response"
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Save and turn on', exact: true })

Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Promotions', exact: true, level: 1 }).or(getByText('A few answers need your attention. We\'ve marked them below.', { exact: true })).or(getByText('We couldn\'t save this promotion', { exact: true })).or(getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Heads up — chain-wide change' })).first()
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Promotions', exact: true, level: 1 })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Promotions', exact: true, level: 1 })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('table', { name: 'Promotions' }).or(getByText('No promotions yet', { exact: true }))
Click getByRole('combobox', { name: /Rows per page/ })
Click getByRole('option', { name: '50', exact: true })
Expect "toHaveText" getByRole('combobox', { name: /Rows per page/ })
Expect "toHaveText" getByRole('table', { name: 'Promotions' }).getByRole('row').filter({ has: getByText('AUTO BOGO 7965fff3', { exact: true }) }).getByRole('cell').nth(3)
